correctness.rationale: Every binary matching incidence vector is extreme. Exact one-edge and two-edge counts T_(n-2),T_(n-4) determine every covariance entry. The orthogonal decomposition of the Johnson line graph yields all three eigenspaces and multiplicities. Strict ordering follows from the ratio bound sqrt(j)<T_j/T_(j-1)<1+sqrt(j) and its two-step consequence p_(n-2)>p_n. A derivative-controlled two-step ratio argument proves lambda_min~1/(2n^(3/2)) and lambda_max~1/n, hence the sharp 2sqrt(n)+O(1) condition number. Exact-rational enumeration for n=4..9 and recurrence checks to 150 independently corroborate the proof; finite checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact vertex-uniform Euclidean second-moment invariant of natural full-dimensional matching 0–1 polytopes in every order n>=4, including all extremal fluctuation directions. The strictly separated modes and sharp sqrt(n) condition-number law are not implied by the known skeleton, facet, inradius or John-ellipsoid results, and they quantify how involution size fluctuations differ from vertex-star and degree-zero edge-flow fluctuations.
